_comment: Photos for the four 55+ community pages, batch 2026-10-a. Found on Wikimedia Commons: 18 on 2026-10-07, 19 more on 2026-10-10. Only CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA. None shows a community itself: Commons has no photo of any of the four. Each photo shows the area around it; the 'what' line says where. Each record has a 600w and a 1200w WebP file (variants, made with tools/photos.js from the Commons 1920 or 1280 px thumbnail; resized, nothing else changed), width and height of the 1200w file, default alt text, the photo's Commons title, and how it reached Commons (provenance). 'file' is the older single 1200 px file that the 2026-10-07 specs use; the 2026-10-10 photos have only the variants. A photo with 'hold' may not be used; tools/photos.js refuses it. Use tools/photos.js (heroPhoto, gallery, featureCards, creditsList), which links the license and the source. Rules: rules/images.md. CC BY-SA: if a photo is cropped or edited, the edited version carries the same license. Each record also has 'place' (IPTC Location Shown and schema contentLocation; the state is South Carolina). The four heroes have 'crops' (1x1, 4x3, 16x9) for Article.image. Every file holds its credit, license and alt text as embedded IPTC/XMP metadata (tools/photos.js embed; rules/image-metadata.md). On 2026-10-11, 6 aerial photos of the communities themselves were added: USDA NAIP 2023 (public domain) from the USGS National Map, with the outline and labels drawn by Chapter3 Realty ('changes'; digital_source_type 'composite'). Each record keeps the exact export request (source_request) and the NAIP tiles under it. Version 10 (2026-10-11): 4 close aerial views of a street of homes, one per community (scratchpad aerial/scripts/build10.js), no drawing, colors adjusted. Version 11 (2026-10-11): the Del Webb North Myrtle Beach street view cut tighter to the houses; the Grande Dunes street view labelled Houses, and a new labelled villas view (scratchpad aerial/scripts/build11.js). Version 12 (2026-10-11): Del Webb North Myrtle Beach from NOAA's 2026 pre-event aerial photos (public domain, flown 2026-01-12, about 0.25 to 0.30 m a pixel against NAIP's 0.6 m, every street built): a labelled overview, a street view, a view from the community to the beach, and Cherry Grove's marsh; plus the Cherry Grove Pier from the ocean (Commons, public domain). The NAIP 2023 records stay for the other pages' history; the 2026 ones replace them on this page (scratchpad eri/scripts/build12.js). Version 13b (2026-10-11): labels on the Del Webb North Myrtle Beach beach view (placed from county geometry through the raw frame's corner coordinates), a new labelled close aerial of its clubhouse, pools and courts, and the Cherry Grove Pier photo cropped to 16:9 (scratchpad eri/scripts/build13b.js). Version 13c (2026-10-11): the beach view's "Beach" dot moved onto the sand (14th Ave S extended to the TIGER coastline) and the pier photo cropped around the pier (scratchpad eri/scripts/build13c.js). Version 13b (2026-10-11): labels on the Del Webb North Myrtle Beach beach view (placed from county geometry through the raw frame's corner coordinates), a new labelled close aerial of its clubhouse, pools and courts, and the Cherry Grove Pier photo cropped to 16:9 (scratchpad eri/scripts/build13b.js).
